# Secrets referenced by workflows (.github/workflows/*.yml).
# Kept name-only (values live in GitHub Actions secrets, never in git).
# CI fails if a workflow references a secret name not listed here,
# so typos get caught instead of silently sending empty values.
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
CONVERGE_ACCOUNT_NO
GH_BOT_TOKEN
GMAIL_CLIENT_ID
GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET
GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN
GMAIL_SMTP_APP_PASSWORD
MAIL_FROM
PDF_PASSWORD
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
USER_EMAIL
USER_MOBILE
